segments.subgoal: Explain the role of software in VR and AR as a driver for hardware to generate sensory experiences.

Compare the ideal developer experience with practical software realities involving SDKs and game engines.
Explain the concept of a Virtual World Generator (VWG) and the different methods for creating virtual environments.
Describe matched motion concepts, including matched zones, tracking, and locomotion methods to manage user experience and cyber-sickness.
Summarize the main points of the lecture.
